Marsriva KP6 EC – Mini Smart DC UPS

This is a compact uninterruptible power supply (UPS), designed specifically for powering small electronic devices like Wi-Fi routers, modems, and CCTV cameras during power outages.


Key Specifications:

  • Output Power: Up to 18W
  • Battery Capacity: 29.6Wh (3.7V / 8000mAh)
  • Battery Type: Lithium-ion
  • Input Voltage: 100–240V AC, 50–60Hz
  • Output Ports: 1 × Passive PoE (24V / 0.75A)

                              3 × DC (12V / 1.5A, 9V / 2.0A, 5V / 2.1A)

                              1 × USB (5V / 2.1A)

  • Weight: Approx. 355g
  • Dimensions: 173mm x 108mm x 31.8mm
  • Operating Temperatures:
  • UPS mode: 0°C to 40°C
  • Battery mode: -15°C to 50°C
  • Build Material: Flame-retardant ABS + PC (V-0 rated)
  • Other Features: 0ms transfer from AC to DC, Wall-mount slots, Air cooling system
